text: Do you travel to the US?
Hi, Ender! I am Jessica, from TextFlow. We send text messages for big companies.
Hi, Jessica. Nice to meet you. What do you do at TextFlow?
I manage the projects for new clients. And you? What do you do?
I am the technology director. I manage the system team. We work with payments.
Interesting! Do you travel to the US for work?
Yes, I do. I travel to the US sometimes. Do you work in Austin?
Yes, I do. I live and work in Austin. Do you send text messages to your clients now?
No, we don’t. That is why we need a provider.
Perfect. We do that every day. Okay, let’s start!
No, we don't send text messages.

Hi, I'm Kate. I work at a bank in Chicago. I manage the credit card team. We are ten people. We work with stores and with other banks. I don't travel a lot for work. I work in the office on Mondays and Tuesdays, and I work from home on Fridays. I love my job, but I don't love Monday mornings!

Hello, my name is Tom. I live in London, and I'm a software developer. I build software for payments: for banks and for online stores. I don't manage people. I like that! I work on a small team, and we have a lot of calls with partners in the US and in India. I work from home on Mondays and Fridays.

Ender and Jessica are online before the meeting. Jessica says: We send text messages for big companies. Ender asks: What do you do at TextFlow? Jessica says: I manage the projects for new clients. Ender says: We don't send text messages. We need a provider.
Our SMS provider is in Texas.
Do you travel? Yes, I do.
No, we don't send text messages.
